china_race_dynamics.text: These data centers, this explosion of data centers is not to make us better compete against the Chinese," Rabb said. "It is to displace massive amounts of workers for the enrichment of the one percent. And I will oppose that.

deepseek.reason: The speaker rejects the claim that data-center expansion is about competing with China, calling it a pretext for enriching the wealthy.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly rejects the China-competition rationale, though it focuses on opposing data centers rather than AI policy broadly.
